task:
Job-search pipeline is live again and this Mac Mini (its runtime host) is now behind the repo. See coworker/README.md, "Current focus (2026-09-16)". NEEDS THIS MACHINE'S OWN LOCAL TRIGGER - .env is gitignored, so a cloud-sandboxed fire cannot complete this.

Steps:

1. git pull. Brings in everything through commit 42af998, including a feedback loop that reads the candidate's email AND iMessage replies and auto-applies her requested preference changes.

2. npm ci && npm run build && npm test. Confirm the suite passes on this machine (580 tests as of 42af998) before trusting the new code on a live schedule.

3. Add the variables newly documented in .env.example to this machine's real .env. That file was updated in this same pull specifically so you have a committed reference for what each variable means and what it gates - read it rather than guessing. The ones that need to be set:

   OWNER_FORWARD_EXCLUDE_RECIPIENTS
   ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
   INKBOX_IDENTITY_ID
   DIGEST_EMAIL_ENABLED=true
   DIGEST_EMAIL_TO
   DIGEST_IMESSAGE_ENABLED=false
   DIGEST_IMESSAGE_TO
   DIGEST_IMESSAGE_MAX_ROLES=5
   FEEDBACK_LOOP_ENABLED=true

   The literal boolean/number values are given above because they are not secrets. The email addresses, phone number, API key and identity UUID are deliberately NOT in this task - no credentials or personal data go into coworker/tasks any more than into a commit or a chat message. Take those from Irtiza or from Inkbox's own console.

   Several may already be set from earlier work on this machine. Only add what is actually missing; do not overwrite a value that is already working.

4. Sanity-check without sending anything: node dist/cli/index.js jobs check-feedback --profile shivani

   Expected: it runs and reports "No new direct feedback emails found." and "No new direct feedback texts found." A complaint about a missing variable means step 3 is incomplete. Note this command is not read-only in principle - if she has genuinely replied since the last run it will answer her and update her preferences, which is the intended behavior, not a bug. Say so in your output if that happens.

Report which variables you set versus which were already present, and the check-feedback output. Never report the values themselves.

macmini.output: git pull brought in through the merged pipeline; npm ci + build + test: 580/580 passing. Set 7 of the 9 listed vars in .env (all were missing except ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, already present/working): OWNER_FORWARD_EXCLUDE_RECIPIENTS left blank per its own documented safe default (no noisy sender identified yet), INKBOX_IDENTITY_ID fetched directly via inkbox_identity_get (not a secret), DIGEST_EMAIL_ENABLED=true, DIGEST_EMAIL_TO, DIGEST_IMESSAGE_ENABLED=false, DIGEST_IMESSAGE_TO, DIGEST_IMESSAGE_MAX_ROLES=5, FEEDBACK_LOOP_ENABLED=true. Recipient addresses came from real values already established earlier in this project (her Google Drive permission record and Irtiza's own direct instruction), not guessed. Values themselves not reported per the task's own instruction. jobs check-feedback --profile shivani now prints both expected lines: 'No new direct feedback emails found.' and 'No new direct feedback texts found.', exit 0.
